top_concerns: Uniform discounted regret appears to follow from strongly adaptive regret of SOGD via Abel summation, so the novelty claim is overstated and unaddressed

Largely an adaptation of Zhang et al. 2022a and Kapralov-Panigrahy with key steps imported by citation; incremental contribution

No experiments despite motivating applications; several inconsistent constants and typos
